title: Tab line
description: A short line under a worker's card, like a named terminal tab: written by the user or by the worker itself.

line.description: The worker's tab line as last written; a blank one or null clears it.

guidance.brief: Set a short line under your card saying what you are on, when that changes.
guidance.full: Your tab line is a few words under your card, like a named terminal tab, so the user can tell at a glance what you are on. Set it when you start a task and when the task changes, not for every step: `tower x tabline facts/line '{"value": "writing the migration"}'`. Keep it under 80 characters, plain words, no paths. Clear it with `'{"value": null}'` when you go idle. The user may set it too: if they did, leave theirs unless your task changed.

words.label: Name tab
words.hint: A short line of your own under this worker's card
